realm_description: The beating civic center of every continent — capitals, universities, and Guild Headquarters all rise here. This is where community becomes something larger than any one person.

primary.label: Craftsman
primary.description: Believes excellence lives in the smallest details; discipline borders on devotion.
primary.guiding_promise: I will refine this until it is right, no matter how long that takes.
primary.shadow_description: Keeps refining what was already good enough, and calls the compulsion discipline.

secondary.label: Democrat
secondary.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
secondary.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
secondary.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

wheel.central_question: Should we control every detail until it's perfect, or trust a process we can't fully control?

growth.label: Democrat
growth.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
growth.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
growth.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

other_ally.label: Ranger
other_ally.description: Moves between civilization and the wild with equal ease; nature trusts them for it.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will walk lightly, so what I protect still has somewhere to stand.
other_ally.shadow_description: Stays so carefully balanced between two worlds that they never fully belong to either.

quarter.label: Inventor
quarter.description: Curiosity-led; comfortable deciding by experiment rather than certainty.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will find a new way where the old ways have run out.
quarter.shadow_description: Abandons every idea the moment a shinier one appears, and finishes nothing.

opposite.label: Farmer
opposite.description: Understands greatness is built on unglamorous, repeated care; trusts slow effort over sudden force.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will tend what grows slowly, trusting the harvest will come.
opposite.shadow_description: Mistakes 'give it time' for permission to never intervene, even as something dies.

realmmate.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
realmmate.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

wheel.compatible_text: Democrat · Bureaucrat — fellow travelers of The Living Heart.
